intended_object: The adjunction ev_c ⊣ R, where ev_c : (C ⥤ D) ⥤ D is evaluation at c and R d = (x ↦ ∏_{x ⟶ c} d), the right Kan extension of d along the functor that picks out c. It exists when D has products indexed by hom-sets. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The hom-set bijection sends f : F c ⟶ d to the natural transformation with components Pi.lift (g ↦ F.map g ≫ f). Its inverse sends α to α_c followed by the projection at 𝟙 c. This is the standard proof that evaluation is a left adjoint. The only hypothesis is that D has products indexed by hom-sets, which is exactly what the right adjoint needs, so the generality is natural. The definition is itself the Mathlib declaration; there is no other, more general Mathlib definition of the same object.
